name: OpenTelemetry Log
description: Ship Drupal log events to an OpenTelemetry log endpoint.
project_description:
Logs events to an OpenTelemetry log endpoint.

 For a full description of the module, visit the project page .

 Submit bug reports and feature suggestions, or track changes in the issue queue .

 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 This module requires the OpenTelemetry API library:

 
 OpenTelemetry API 
 
 Back to top 

 Recommended libraries 
 This module doesn’t do anything outside an OpenTelemetry context. The OpenTelemetry SDK provides various ways on how a context can be created and propagated throughout an application.

 
 OpenTelemetry SDK 
 
 Zero-code instrumentation 
 SDK Autoloading 
 
 
 
 The Drupal OpenTelemetry SDK integration module provides a straight forward way to configure and autoload the OT SDK via settings.php .

 One of the exporter libraries is required in order to ship logs to an OpenTelemetry endpoint.

 
 OpenTelemetry Registry 
 
 Back to top 

 Installation 
 Install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module. For further information, see Installing Drupal Modules .

 Add one or more of the recommended libraries using composer .

 Back to top 

 Configuration 
 
 Enable the module at Administration > Extend. 
 Either setup Zero-code instrumentation or SDK Autoloading and supply an appropriate configuration.
